manual_test_checklist: [ ] Start all services with docker-compose up -d
[ ] Verify Langfuse UI accessible at http://localhost:3000
[ ] Verify Redis connected via redis-cli ping
[ ] Verify PostgreSQL connected via psql
[ ] Start backend with python backend/app.py
[ ] Check /observability/health returns healthy
[ ] Send RAG query and verify trace_id returned
[ ] Check Langfuse UI shows trace with all spans
[ ] Send chat query (hello) and verify route=chat
[ ] Send two messages in same session, verify memory persists
[ ] Send memory query and verify route=memory
[ ] Trigger HITL with risky keyword, verify hitl_triggered=true
[ ] Check /hitl/pending shows pending review
[ ] Approve HITL review via /hitl/{id}/approve
[ ] Run evaluation: python backend/evaluation/run_eval.py --lang en
[ ] Verify evaluation results saved to backend/evaluation/results/
[ ] Test streaming endpoint /chat/stream
[ ] Clear session via /chat/clear
[ ] Check Redis for session data persistence
[ ] Verify PostgreSQL hitl_reviews table populated
[ ] Test with Chinese queries (lang=zhtw)
[ ] Verify all Langfuse spans show correct metadata
[ ] Check system stats via /observability/stats
[ ] Flush traces via /observability/flush

chat_agent.triggers: Greetings (hi, hello, thanks, goodbye) in short queries

memory_agent.triggers: References to past conversation (earlier, previously, what did I)

conditions: risky keywords: legal, claim, policy, liability, contract, confidential
